mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.2%, it indicates aggressive monetary easing that stimulates economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.0%), a sustained increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0% and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600,000 units, it signals strong residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates accommodative monetary policy amid rising inflation, which precedes equity market gains and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase (GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE > 8.0%), rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening manufacturing sector and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE > 8.0% and INDPRO rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
